opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 945.] Motions of Ron Paul et al., Sandra Banning, American Civil Rights Union, and American Jewish Congress for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Justice Scalia took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
